item.title: Middle East live: US targets Iranian vessels, missile sites in new strikes
item.description: US forces struck missile sites and vessels allegedly laying naval mines in southern Iran late on Monday, the United States Central Command said. The strikes, which the Pentagon said were taken "in self-defence", threaten to further destabilise a fragile ceasefire as Iranian negotiators are in Doha for high-stakes talks aimed at ending the war. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Possible Iran-US deal: What we know about the key issues on both sides
item.description: The United States and Iran have downplayed prospects for a rapid deal to end the Middle East war, despite signs of progress in talks. Key sticking points remain over Iran’s nuclear programme, control of the Strait of Hormuz, sanctions relief and a possible ceasefire in Lebanon, with both sides signalling that major issues are still unresolved.

item.title: Israel pounds Lebanon with fresh air strikes, vows to 'crush' Hezbollah
item.description: Israel intensified air strikes across southern and eastern Lebanon on Monday after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to “crush” Hezbollah, deepening fears of a wider regional conflict. The escalation comes despite an April ceasefire and as another round of US-Iran talks takes place in Doha in a bid to negotiate terms for a broader Middle East peace deal.

item.title: As Delegations Gather in Qatar For Talks, U.S. Strikes Iran’s Gulf Coast
item.description: Iranian officials went to Doha on Monday for the negotiations, hours before the U.S. military announced the strikes it said were intended to protect troops. Israel’s leader said his country plans to intensify attacks against Hezbollah, Iran’s ally, in Lebanon.
